instruction: Look at one point and blink naturally.
Read text on the screen and blink naturally.
Watch a video and blink naturally.
Try single, double, hard, and slow blinks, with pauses.
Look left and right, up and down, then track a moving point.
Raise eyebrows, clench jaw, swallow, then move your head.
Close both eyes and keep still. Reopen when recording ends.
